name: typesafe-as-a-judge
description: Bounded TypeSafe Jev judgments for routing, ranking, extraction, verification, and escalation.

interface.shortDescription: Typed Jev judgments with confidence-aware review gates.
interface.longDescription: Use TypeSafe Jev for bounded semantic judgments. The plugin can route, rank, select pre-parsed values, verify evidence, and recommend review; it never performs the resulting action.
defaultPrompt: Route these support requests and flag uncertain results for review.
Rank these implementation candidates against this requirement.
Verify these claims against their supporting evidence.
